topic: The Essence of Abstract Vector Spaces

sections.title: From Concrete Arrows to Abstract Rules
lecture_lines: Vectors start as arrows with magnitude and direction.
We now focus on how they behave under operations.
Think of these as abstract objects in a set.
They follow specific rules, regardless of their appearance.
animations: Animate vector transformation into a point using color #33FF57.
Overlay labels 'V' for space and 'x' for point, incorporating the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] for precise alignment.

sections.title: The 8 Axioms: The 'Rulebook' of the Space
lecture_lines: A Vector Space requires two operations: addition and scaling.
These must satisfy eight fundamental axioms.
Think of these as the laws of physics.
animations: Display list of 8 axioms in color #FFFF00 alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rulebook.svg].
Highlight the 'Additive Identity' axiom with color #FF33FF.

sections.title: Beyond Arrows: Function Spaces
lecture_lines: Functions like polynomials can also be vectors.
Summing two functions yields another function.
This expands our horizon beyond physical geometry.
animations: Show curve with color #00FFFF and display [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].
Animate function 'f(x)' mapping to output value.

sections.title: Visualizing Closure: The Gatekeeper
lecture_lines: Closure is our most important filter.
Operations must keep elements within the space.
animations: Visualise vector addition using color #FFA500 with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fence.svg] to define the boundary.
Show resultant vector within same boundary in color #00FF00.

sections.title: Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: Abstract spaces allow structured linear combinations.
This unifies arrows, matrices, and functions.
It powers data science and modern physics.
